en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.title: Trusted Locations
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.keywords: trust trusted safe mode folder location workspace project
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.foldersHelp: Projects anywhere inside these folders open trusted without asking, except the ones you chose to keep in safe mode. Changes take effect when you click Apply or OK.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.empty: No trusted locations. Lithe asks before opening each project you haven't trusted.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.rootLocation: A disk or filesystem root cannot be a trusted location: it would trust every project on that disk.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.listFull: This trust list is full (256 entries). Remove one before adding another.
en-US.desktop.trustedLocations.directoryNone: No trusted folders; untrusted projects ask before opening

zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.title: 可信位置
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.keywords: 信任 可信 安全模式 文件夹 位置 工作区 项目
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.foldersHelp: 这些文件夹内任意层级的项目都直接以信任方式打开，不再询问；你选择保持安全模式的项目除外。点击“应用”或“确定”后生效。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.empty: 没有可信位置。打开尚未信任的项目时会先询问。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.rootLocation: 磁盘或文件系统的根目录不能作为可信位置，否则会信任该磁盘上的所有项目。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.listFull: 信任列表已满（最多 256 项），请先删除一项再添加。
zh-CN.desktop.trustedLocations.directoryNone: 没有可信文件夹，打开未信任的项目时会先询问
